payload.title: Freeze randomized long-horizon mask-task worth screen
payload.decision: Execute T026 exactly as preregistered before any neural or formal sequence implementation.
payload.rationale: T025 proves unique legal coefficient-dynamics signal and a 4.113743 oracle, but four fixed short pseudo-cuts fail spatial/typewell transfer. Score-blind metadata supports 12,216 causal end-of-well tasks whose median horizon matches the real hidden horizon. The next evidence question is whether task augmentation and horizon balancing improve transfer, not whether a larger architecture can fit the same 773 labels.
payload.revisit_trigger: No held-out-well task may enter fitting or transforms. Complete all 19 branches, four placements, 35 contexts, controls, edge cases, and reproduction. Apply the pre-score control alignment and exact-E011 scoring definitions in tracking/evidence/T026/PRE_SCORE_AMENDMENT.md. No neural model, Kaggle execution, package, or submission is authorized.
